summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository. Changes: SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 added to ControlType in rich/segment.py, with Tuple[ControlType, str] added to the ControlCode union. rich/control.py gained the formatting entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title(title) classmethod. rich/console.py gained set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, which writes the control when is_terminal and returns True, otherwise False. rich/_windows_renderer.py gained one SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests were added in tests/test_control.py, tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not run: tests and Black, per instructions; added lines were checked by hand to be within 88 characters. Nothing was committed.
